attributes.title: MA-AUA 85th Annual Meeting
attributes.series: Mid-Atlantic Section of the AUA Annual Meeting
attributes.organizer: Mid-Atlantic Section of the American Urological Association
attributes.summary:
Urologists in the Mid-Atlantic region meet in Baltimore on September 9 to 11, 2027. A section meeting is a smaller, closer-to-home alternative to the national AUA, and it is often easier for community practices to attend.

The section published an accreditation notice for its 2026 meeting. The 2027 credit total and fees are not published yet. For a rough budget, 2026 physician rates were $400 for active members and $425 for nonmembers.
